Ṭoḍaraprakāśa
dh. written under Ṭoḍaramalla, minister of Akbar, by Raghunandanamiśra.

Ṭoḍaramalla
or Rājā Ṭoḍar Mal.. Akbar's finance minister an. great patron of learning; [Page003-b] belonged to the Kṣhattriya family of Ṭaṇḍaṇa of Oudh; son of Bhāgavatīdāsa; died in 1589 A. D.; patronized pandits an. arranged for the compilation of a. encyclopaedic work, Ṭoḍarānanda.
See below.

Ṭoḍarmalla

Ṭoḍarānanda
or Toḍarānanda; encyclopaedic work prepared under the patronage an. personal direction of Rājā Ṭoḍar Mal., by several scholars of Benares under the general editorship of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa during 1572-89 A. D.; the Jyotiṣasaukhya section was prepared by Nīlakaṇṭha, son of Ananta (See Poona Ori. II. p. 222); according to intro. portion the work is in 22 sections called Saukhyas; besides Āgamasaukhya is also found in mss.; while sections on Rājanīti an. Karmavipāka are not available in mss.
[For details of the sections see App. C. of P. L. Vaidya's edn. of Ṭoḍarānanda, Vol. I].
